name: Do I need to prime after repairing a drywall crack?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime after repairing a drywall crack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, priming after repairing a drywall crack is highly recommended. Primer seals the repaired area, preventing the new paint from absorbing unevenly into the patch material, which can cause a dull spot or 'flashing.' It also provides a uniform surface for the topcoat, ensuring a smooth, consistent finish that blends seamlessly with the surrounding wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, prime after repair to seal the patch, prevent uneven paint absorption, and ensure a smooth, consistent final paint finish.
